== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Steelborn body, also known as the Steelborn [[Iron body]], is a specialized type of [[Iron body]]. While its full potential may not be apparent until a user surpasses the [[Gold]] realm, it is reputed to be the premier [[Iron body]] for achieving immense physical strength once an individual reaches the [[Underlord]] stage. This specific body type is characterized by its ability to grow and become sharper through various stages of development. It functions by drawing [[madra]] from the user to fuel its immense power, though this process can be physically taxing and painful. In combat, the Steelborn body provides overwhelming physical strength that can allow a user to match or exceed opponents who possess different specialized bodies.}}
